dan_customer: Hey team — after upgrading our app's dependency to redwood-python 1.41 we started seeing streaming completions return a single empty chunk then close. Also noticed a bunch of 401s and a latency jump from ~120ms to ~700ms yesterday. Any idea?

maria_support: ah sorry to hear that, can you paste the exact pip line and the minimal snippet you use to stream?

dan_customer: pip freeze shows redwood==1.41.0, python 3.10. snippet:```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'), timeout=30)
resp = client.stream_complete(model='mistral-large', prompt='hello')
for chunk in resp:
    print(chunk.text)
```

We see one chunk with '' then the generator stops. Also logs show occasional 401s: `HTTP 401 Unauthorized - token invalid` even though key is fine.

sam_engineer: thanks — couple of quick checks: 1) did you also upgrade any transitive packages (httpx/requests)? 2) can you confirm you don't have both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_KEY set? we've seen env var precedence oddities in the past.

dan_customer: only redwood and our app, httpx stayed at 0.23.3. env has REDWOOD_KEY only. Auth failures look intermittent every ~20 requests. Billing-wise we got a small spike yesterday. Could be retries?

maria_support: can you run with DEBUG=redwood:* and paste the trace? Also, what's your retry policy (default vs custom)?

dan_customer: default policy. attaching trimmed debug:```
[2026-02-12T14:02:01Z] request id=abc123 method=POST /v1/streams status=200 latency=0.12s
[2026-02-12T14:02:01Z] stream id=xyz chunk='' end=true
[2026-02-12T14:02:05Z] request id=abc124 method=POST /v1/streams status=401 latency=0.05s
[2026-02-12T14:02:06Z] retry count=1 reason=401
[2026-02-12T14:02:06Z] request id=abc125 method=POST /v1/streams status=200 latency=0.70s
[2026-02-12T14:02:06Z] stream id=xyz2 chunk='' end=true
```

maria_support: that looks like the server returning tiny empty streams and the client treating them as complete. There's a change in 1.41 where the streaming helper's default behavior around empty-fragment filtering was tightened (was lenient before). If your model sometimes emits control-only frames, the client may now surface an empty final chunk.

eric_oncall: adding context — we shipped a fix that normalizes client-side retry on 401s (previously caused immediate retry loops causing double billing). unfortunately the 1.41 client also changed the streaming iteration to return an early empty chunk when `__anext__` sees a terminal control frame. We're working on making the old lenient behavior an alias for a grace period.

dan_customer: any recommended workaround until a patched client drops?

maria_support: two options: 1) pin to the last known-good release (1.40.2) which keeps previous semantics, or 2) apply a small local wrapper to filter empty chunks:```py
for chunk in client.stream_complete(...):
    if not getattr(chunk, 'text', None):
        continue
    print(chunk.text)
```
We also suggest adding a short sleep/backoff on 401s in your app logics to avoid tight immediate retries while we investigate server-side token validation flakiness.

sam_engineer: to pin: `pip install 'redwood==1.40.2'` — that'll avoid the streaming change and the stricter empty-fragment behavior. We'll push a 1.41.1 with a compatibility alias for streaming iteration early next week.

dan_customer: ok pinning now, will monitor latency and billing. Is there any risk of data loss by filtering empty chunks?

maria_support: no data loss if chunks are truly empty control frames; those never contained model tokens. But if your app relied on the final empty event as a signal, then use a small flag instead. Example:```py
finished=False
for chunk in client.stream_complete(...):
    if not chunk.text and not finished:
        finished=True
        continue
    if chunk.text:
        process(chunk.text)
```

eric_oncall: we're also opening an internal ticket to correlate 401 spikes with token issuer rate limits — will update this thread when we have server-side traces. If you can share request ids (abc123 style) we'll attach them.

dan_customer: shared request ids via DM to maria_support. After pin we saw streams back to normal. Thanks for the quick triage. :raised_hands:

maria_support: great — leaving this open until the patch ships. If anyone else sees similar behavior please +1 here and include your redwood version and python version. :thumbsup:
